content: {"episode_id":"ep-05079","cpt":"93271","denial_carc":"CO-97","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-97 denial of CPT 93271 (cardiac event monitoring), which Cornerstone United determined was bundled into another covered procedure and not separately payable. The clinical indication note documents a patient with a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks (G45.9) and unspecified cardiac arrhythmia (I49.9), reporting intermittent episodes of dizziness and palpitations that are poorly correlated with standard ECG findings. Per the indication, the cardiac event monitoring study is indicated to evaluate for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation or other intermittent dysrhythmias that may be contributing to these transient neurological symptoms. We therefore request reconsideration and separate payment of the outstanding balance of 337.79 for this distinct, separately indicated service."}
